title: Dungeon Farm Magma Open Source
features:
Insane farm open source since everyone wants to make it paid

there is no autostore or  webhook add it yourself :)
script:
pcall(function()
    if game.PlaceId == 6360478118 then
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Queue"):InvokeServer("Dungeon")
    elseif game.PlaceId == 11424731604 then
        task.wait(20)
        local args = {"Magma Swamp"}
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Skill"):InvokeServer(unpack(args))
        task.wait(1)
        
        local function MagmaDamage(Pos)
            for _, v in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") and string.find(v.Name, game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then
                    v:FireServer(Pos)
                end
            end
        end
        
        local WaveToQuitAt = 25
        local StartPos = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        
        while true do
            task.wait()
            for i,v in pairs(workspace.NPCs:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    if string.find(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Matchmake.Wave.Text, tostring(WaveToQuitAt)) then
                        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("KnockedOut"):FireServer("self")
                    else
                        MagmaDamage(v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)
                        local UPTy = StartPos * CFrame.new(0, 40, 0)
                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = UPTy
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
